Belle’s father is sentenced to death for picking a rose from Beast’s garden. Belle offers to go back to the Beast in her father’s place. Beast falls in love with her and tests her by letting her return home but telling her that if she doesn’t return to him within a week, he will die of grief.
On the windswept and sea battered Breton coast two young sailors make their livelihood collecting seaweed, on an offshore island they burn the seaweed to harness its chemicals.

FilmTitle: The Fall of the House of Usher
databaseFilmTitle: The Fall of the House of Usher
AlternateTitle: La chute de la maison Usher
synopsis: A stranger called Allan goes to the House of Usher. He is the sole friend of Roderick Usher, who lives in the eerie house with his sick wife Madeleine. When she dies, Roderick does not accept her death, and in the dark night, Madeleine returns.

Marie wants to escape from her job and also from her lover, Paul, an unemployed drunk. She dreams of going off with Jean, a dockworker. The two men quarrel and fight over Marie on two occasions, but Paul retains a hold over her.

FilmTitle: The Tempest: Poem on the Sea
databaseFilmTitle: The Tempest: Poem on the Sea
synopsis: Despite her protestations and concerns over ominous signs, a young woman’s lover leaves for the sea to fish for sardines, but while he is out a terrible storm strikes. However, she finds out about Le Tempestaire, or Tempest Master, who has the power to speak to the wind and subdue it.

Psychological narrative avantgarde film about a wealthy young businessman who consecutively falls in love with a classy English woman (Pearl), a Russian sculptress (Athalia), and a naive working-class girl (Lucie).
Ballad-type drama-documentary spoken in the Breton language and set in a Breton fishing community, telling of the impossible love between a fisherman and the lady of the manor.

Alexandre is an idle, self-absorbed young intellectual living in Paris, spending most of his days lecturing his friends on political and philosophical topics. While living off his girlfriend, Marie, he chases other girls. He soon meets Veronika, a liberated woman, and a rocky ménage à trois ensues.

In a sleepy village, young teen Daniel lives with his grandmother and enjoys a carefree existence with his similarly innocent peers. But when his mother arrives, Daniel is pulled out of school and forced to work, where he falls in with an older crowd that is far more experienced in dating and sex.

A group of friends listen as one man tells them a story about a time when, in a small cafe, he discovered a peephole into the ladies’ bathroom and became addicted to looking through it at female genitals. They ask him questions and come to conclusions about sex.

Jean Eustache films his 70-year-old grandmother Odette as she recounts her life—her childhood, her losses, her unfaithful husband, the children she lost, and the hardships she endured. She also expresses her concern for her grandson and great-grandson, whom she hopes to see grow up.

AlternateTitle: Le père Noël a les yeux bleus
synopsis: In Jean Eustache’s delightfully salacious short comedy, an impoverished young Parisian takes a job as a department store Santa, and soon discovers that his bearded guise allows him to do things he had previously only dreamed of.

Spring 1968, Pessac. Twenty local dignitaries gather with the mayor to choose the most virtuous young woman as the “Rosière of Pessac.” The ceremony follows a strict ritual: the dowry presentation, a procession led by a brass band, the Mass, speeches, and a banquet featuring traditional songs.
Two prisoners in complete isolation, separated by the thick brick walls, and desperately in need of human contact, devise a most unusual kind of communication.
Comedy: A well-known dramatic writer has decided to kill his blackmailer, but the problem is, what should he do with the body? Based on the play “The Gazebo” by Alec Coppel.

The wife of a mechanic and former fighter pilot falls in love with the idea of flying herself. This soon becomes an obsession and she undertakes a lofty feat: the longest solo flight ever made by a woman.

For André and the other crew members of the Cyclone, existence is divided between the stormy seas and the safety of life at home with their wives. When André meets temptation in the form of the alluring Catherine during a risky rescue, he comes perilously close to betraying his wife of 10 years.

Marie Prieur, a young doctor, decides to settle down on a remote island belonging to Brittany. Little by little she manages to be accepted by the population. One day she meets André Lorenzi, a handsome engineer. Life is wonderful for a while but André wants to marry her only if she remains at home.

A shimmering glass hotel at the top of a remote Provençal mountain provides the setting for a tragicomic tapestry about an obsessive love pentangle, whose principals range from an artist to a hotel manager to a dam worker.
After three weeks and a long, hot voyage across the Pacific, an ocean liner finally arrives at its destination, Ecuador.  That evening, the event is marked by a masked ball and a magic show.

Lucien Bourrache, a handsome spahi non-commissioned officer, is nicknamed Gueule d’amour because women like him. He is forced to leave for Nice to collect an inheritance. Shortly after his arrival, he falls in love with a young woman who loses her entire inheritance gambling.

This short film explores the unusual reproductive cycle of seahorses, where the female gives the male eggs for both fertilisation and birth. The film is replete with scientific detail: Jean Painlevé’s narration guides our attention, and even reveals the drumming heartbeat of a newborn seahorse.

The Vampire travels to South America to observe the habit of a vampire bat that kills small animals by draining all their blood and kills large ones by leaving a parasite in their bloodstream. Jean Painlevé draws a connection between the vampire bat and the film creatures of the same name.

FilmTitle: The Old Country Where Rimbaud Died
databaseFilmTitle: The Old Country Where Rimbaud Died
AlternateTitle: Le vieux pays où Rimbaud est mort
synopsis: The Old Country Where Rimbaud Died follows Abel as he sets out on an odyssey to France to visit the land of his ancestors. While on his trip, Abel discovers that the France he’d been taught to believe in no longer exists, and that his distance from the old country is more than geographical.

A government official, Count Muffat, falls under the spell of Nana, a young actress. She becomes his mistress, living in the sumptuous apartment which he provides for her. Instead of elevating herself to Muffat’s level, however, Nana drags the poor man down to hers.

At the onset of World War II, a weekend at a Marquis’ country château lays bare some ugly truths about a group of haut bourgeois acquaintances. The Rules of the Game is a scathing critique of corrupt French society, cloaked in a comedy of manners.

A group of French soldiers, including an aristocratic captain and a working-class lieutenant, grapple with their class differences as they are held in a WWI German prison camp. When transferred to a high-security fortress ruled by an aristocratic German officer, the men must concoct an escape plan.
The family of a Parisian shop-owner spends a day in the country. The daughter falls in love to a man at the inn, where they spend the day. Released in 1946, ten years after it was shot.

Monsieur Lange is a publishing house clerk who writes pulp Western novels in his spare time. When his untrustworthy boss Batala avoids his debt collectors by pretending to be dead, Lange and his co-workers take over the business and thrive on the popularity of Lange’s stories, until Batala returns…
The story concentrates on a gang of thieves who utilize a cross-road garage as the hideaway.

Boudu, a homeless Parisian man, takes a suicidal plunge into the Seine and is rescued by wealthy bookseller Mr. Lestingois. The latter decides to take Boudu in, not knowing he will shake the Lestingois household to its foundations. However, when Boudu wins the lottery, events take a different turn.

Danglard is a mentor and a lover of the stage stars of 1890s Paris. When he discovers a naive young laundress dancing in a nightclub, he is inspired by her talent to revive the long-forgotten cancan in a show that the whole of Paris, rich and poor, will never forget.

Cashier Maurice Legrand is married to Adele, a terror. By chance, he meets Lucienne, Lulu, and makes her his mistress. He thinks he finally met love, but Lulu is nothing but a streetwalker, in love with Dede, her pimp. She only accepts Legrand to satisfy Dede’s needs of money.

Director Jean Renoir’s entrancing first color feature—shot entirely on location in India—is a visual tour de force. Based on the novel by Rumer Godden, the film eloquently contrasts the growing pains of three young women with the immutability of the holy Bengal River.

Camilla, the star of a theater company, hesitates between three men. A young Spanish officer, the Viceroy who gives her his magnificent golden coach and Ramon, a torero, who offers her a share of his glory. As the threat of war looms, she soon finds she must make painful decisions about her future.

In the 1920s, the Provence is a magnet for immigrants seeking work in the quarries or in the agriculture. Many mingle with locals and settle down permanently —like Toni, an Italian who has moved in with Marie, a Frenchwoman.

On board a train bound for the port city of Le Havre, railroad stationmaster Roubard murders a man who seduced his young wife Severine. Engineer Jacques Lantier also begins a passionate affair with Severine, who takes little time in suggesting that Jacques should get rid of her controlling husband.

An upper-class corporal from Paris is captured by the Germans when they invade France in 1940. Assisted and accompanied by a diverse bunch of characters, the corporal tries to escape from prison camps, sometimes making it a few yards, sometimes reaching the French border.

Etienne Alexis, a candidate for the presidency of the new Europe, is a pompous scientist promoting artificial insemination. However, while hosting a picnic, he encounters a young, modern peasant woman, Nénette, and learns that science sometimes does not have all the answers.

A news-reel like movie about the early part of the French Revolution shown from the eyes of individual people, citizens of Marseille, counts in German exile and, of course, King Louis XVI, showing their own small problems.

Pre-World War I Paris: Polish countess Elena drives men of all stations to fits of desperate love. When she elicits the fascination of a famous general, Elena finds herself at the center of political scheming, with the hearts of several men—as well as the future of France—in her hands.

Maître Joly becomes concerned when his friend, Dr. Cordelier draws up a will that bequeaths his entire estate to a violent stranger, Monsieur Opale. After a colleague is killed, Joly confronts Cordelier and discovers the truth behind his friend’s behaviour.

This erotic horror film, set in 1905, tells the story of a thief who seeks refuge in a castle owned by two women, Eva (Brigitte Lahaie) and Elizabeth (Franca Mai). The women are seductive and teasing, but turn out to be part of a vampiric cult of blood-drinking aristocrats.

The film depicts an ordinary week in the lives of Nigerians who have migrated to Abidjan, Côte d’Ivoire for work. “Edward G. Robinson” narrates, commenting on his experiences and describing the bitter reality of life in a poor suburb populated by migrants, and his work as a day laborer in the ports.

Set in a mixed school for white and coloured pupils at Abidjan, this docu-drama shows how working together to make the film changes their attitude towards each other. The arrival of Nadine, a new student, is also the starting point for a discussion about interracial relationships.
Inverting the familiar narrative of a Frenchman traveling to Africa, Little by Little instead finds a Nigerian visiting Paris as research to build a grand building in his home village.

Filmed it Ghana, the film depicts the annual ceremony of the Hauku cult, a social and religious movement which was widespread in French colonial Africa from the 1920’s to the 1950’s. In a shared trance, the participants begin to mimic the elaborate military ceremonies of their colonial occupiers…

Lam, an itinerant chicken merchant at the time, Damouré and Tallou Mouzourine, go through the bush with the real star of the film, Lam’s car, a “patience mobile” that endlessly breaks down, provoking an equal number of step by step improvised solutions and improvised filming.

Three young men from Niger decide to emigrate to Ghana: each descend from warriors, but the more immediate challenge is finding a job. After an arduous journey, they make it across the border, at which point they separate. Their lives will continue to cross, separate, and then come together again.

In a repressive all-boys boarding school with rigid rules of behavior, students decide to rebel and set about turning the institution’s uptight rules on their head. Their revolt includes pranks, epic battles, and ill-advised schemes.

Following a whirlwind romance, barge captain Jean marries country girl Juliette. They board the L’Atalante to embark on their new married life together. But within the boat’s cramped confines, shared with a small crew and an abundance of cats, the relationship begins to founder.

This documentary and cinematic poem captures the life and the essence of the seaside resort of Nice, while portraying the contrasting lifestyles of its inhabitants. Starting with a series of aerial takes, Jean Vigo’s film continues with scenes that pivot around the Promenade des Anglais.
The fortunes of a small theatrical company based in the Paris suburbs.

The vicissitudes of thirteen-year-old Bruno, who has to stay on his feet in a poor suburb of Paris. This flamboyant film with a documentary, occasionally violent approach mixes realism, dream and lyricism.

The Enclosed Valley is shot in Super-8 film. There is no dialogue and almost all of the “action” appears to be natural, as if the camera was just set up and left to run, with no pans, zooms or motion at all.

What makes this film distinctive is the way Rousseau explicitly returns to the source of his creative inspiration. So here he is at home reciting «Bérénice» to himself, whilst going about his household chores.
A military veteran and former mercenary named Frenchy (JCVD) is haunted by his childhood, as well as his past in the military. Now living in Eastern Asia, he is hiding, working as a taxi driver.

Pollet’s seminal Mediterranee cuts repeatedly between meditative camera movements around various subjects–Greek ruins, a Sicilian garden, a Spanish bullfight, a woman on a hospital cart, a fisherman–conjuring up a great many mysteries about their relation to one another.
François leads a quiet, uneventful life with his wife and children. One day, on the cover of a detective novel, he finds the picture of his old friend Leo, who he has not seen for 25 years…

When the easygoing novelist Zorg meets the tempestuous and impulsive Betty in a sunbaked French beach town, it’s the beginning of a whirlwind passionate love affair. But as the increasingly erratic Betty’s grip on reality begins to falter, Zorg finds himself willing to do things he never expected.

On impulse, Ferdinand abandons his bourgeois existence with his wife and child to take off with Marianne, an old flame. Being pursued by foreign thugs, they embark on a haphazard crime spree, a crazy adventure involving fast cars, mysterious gangsters, and a Mediterranean idyll that turns sour.

Paul Javal is hired to write a script for a new film version of Homer’s ’The Odyssey’. But the screenwriter soon finds himself torn between the demands of a proud European director, a crude and arrogant American producer, and Camille, his disillusioned wife.

FilmTitle: 2 or 3 Things I Know About Her
databaseFilmTitle: 2 or 3 Things I Know About Her
synopsis: Juliette Janson, a housewife from the Paris suburbs, lives in a high-rise apartment with her husband and two children. As consumer culture in Paris booms, Juliette decides to start a part-time job as a sex worker to afford some of life’s little luxuries and escape suburbia.

Petty thug Michel panics and impulsively kills a policeman while driving a stolen car. On the lam, he turns to his aspiring journalist girlfriend Patricia, hiding out in her Paris apartment. When she learns that Michel is being investigated for murder, Patricia begins to question her loyalty.

AlternateTitle: Vivre sa vie: Film en douze tableaux
synopsis: Nana, a restless young Parisian, descends into prostitution when her aspirations to become an actress falter. Recently separated from her husband, Nana is completely alone except for her heartless pimp and the women she knows from hooking in the banlieue.

An unhappily married bourgeois couple, each planning to murder the other, embark on a weekend getaway to the countryside. The apocalypse begins on the road: endless traffic jams, terrible accidents, and ambulance sirens. Stuck on this nightmare trip, they begin to encounter some strange characters.

In France to shoot a TV project, a film director named Jerzy is over budget and uninspired. While on the set of his movie, he becomes interested in the unfolding struggle of a young factory worker, Isabelle. She has been fired by her boss Michel, who did not approve her union activities.

Paul is young, just demobbed from service in the French Army, and disillusioned with civilian life. While his girlfriend builds herself a career as a pop singer, Paul becomes more isolated from his peers and from their social politics.

In industrial Switzerland, the problems of a married couple in collapse intertwine with the experiences of a country girl. Denise abandons her husband, her job, and the city to work on a farm in the countryside. Meanwhile, Isabelle leaves the countryside to become a sex worker in the city.

AlternateTitle: Alphaville, une étrange aventure de Lemmy Caution
synopsis: Lemmy Caution is on a mission to eliminate Professor Von Braun, the creator of a malevolent computer that rules a city. Befriended by the scientist’s daughter Natasha, Lemmy must unravel the mysteries of the strictly logical Alpha 60 and teach Natasha the meaning of the word “love.”

Charlotte aimlessly drifts between morning affairs with the artistic Robert and mundane evenings with her paternalistic husband Pierre. Unsure of whether she loves either man, Charlotte discovers she is pregnant and must come to terms with her emotional infidelities.

Arthur and Franz, two small-time crooks with a love of American b-movies, enlist the object of their shared affection, Odile, to help them steal cash from her family home. But things go awry after Arthur’s uncle learns of their plot and wants to commit the robbery himself, forcing them to rush it.

In an unnamed land, unscrupulous soldiers recruit poor farmers with promises of an easy and happy life. Two farmers, Michelangelo and Ulysses head off to war for their king. When they return from their battles, they show their wives a series of photographs supposedly documenting their travels.

A video project begun by Jean-Luc Godard in the late 1980s and completed in 1998. The densest of Godard’s films, Histoire(s) du cinéma is an examination of the history of the concept of cinema and how it relates to the 20th century.
Elena Torlato-Favrini, a headstrong Italian countess and heiress to a business empire, considers herself superior to any man.

A married woman and a single man meet. They love, they argue, fists fly. At the same time, a dog strays between town and country elsewhere. As the seasons pass, the man and woman meet again, and the dog finds itself between them. Then, a second film begins: it looks like the first, and yet is not.

Carmen X, the female member of a terrorist gang, asks her uncle Jean if she can borrow his beachside house to make a film with some friends. In reality, her clan is planning on robbing a bank. During the burglary, Carmen falls in love with a security guard and will attempt to escape with him…

Exotic dancer Angela attempts to have a child with her unwilling lover Emile. But Alfred, Emile’s best friend who is in love with Angela, is happy to be a father. Angela loves Emile and refuses Alfred’s advances, but leads Emile to believe that she is infatuated with his friend.

Godard’s film essay delves into cinema’s history and modern world. He manipulates film fragments, reflecting on dissonance. His voice guides through metaphysical musings, anchored by an obsession with images, offering a poignant ontological exploration.

Someone we hear talking – but whom we do not see – speaks of a project which describes the four key moments of love: meeting, physical passion, arguments and separation, making up. This is told through three couples.

Everything returns to normal after Chernobyl. That is, everything but art. Most of the great works are lost, and it is up to people like William Shakespear Junior the Fifth to restore the lost artwork of the human race.

A symphony in three movements: passengers circle one another in a Mediterranean cruise; a sister and her brother in the French countryside demand explanations from their parents; and an essay-tour of six sites of myth—Egypt, Palestine, Odessa, Hellas, Naples and Barcelona.

Explosive sequences from nature abut those consisting of passionate discussions by two couples. One pair argues in dialogue spoken by the lovers in the novel The Postman Always Rings Twice, by James Cain; the other couple quotes a tale by Edgar Allan Poe.
Divided into three “kingdoms” — Enfer (Hell), Purgatoire (Purgatory) and Paradis (Paradise) — Notre Musique is an indictment of modern times.

FilmTitle: Six fois deux/Sur et sous la communication
databaseFilmTitle: Six fois deux/Sur et sous la communication
synopsis: The title and subtitle of this French miniseries are “Six Times Two; Over and under the media”. The “six” refers to the fact that there are six episodes; the “two” has a double meaning.

In a Paris hotel, a hotel detective—fired after a murder took place there—continues to investigate the death, helped by his inspector nephew and girlfriend. Meanwhile, boxing trainer Jim Fox Warner is praying that his boy will win so he can pay back the Mafia.

Commissioned by the heads of the 2000 Cannes Film Festival to make an opening-night short commemorating cinema as it enters its second full century, Godard instead offers up re-edited footage of wars and Nazi atrocities, interspersed with clips of “Gigi” and his own “À bout de souffle.”
Just after the fall of the Berlin Wall, Lemmy Caution roams around the city aimlessly. The film is part narrative and part documentary, an essay picture about German history and politics.

Godard’s segment of Ten Minutes Older: The Cello shows the audience a real Pandora’s box, which seems to hide all the horrors of the world: the last moments of youth, fame, thoughts, memory, love, silence, history, fear, eternity, cinema.
In Scénario du film Passion, Godard constructs a lyrical study of the cinematic and creative process by deconstructing the story of his 1982 film Passion.

An analysis of the social upheaval of May 1968 made in the immediate wake of the workers’ and students’ protests. The picture consists of two parts, each with identical image tracks, and differing narration.

AlternateTitle: La Chinoise, ou plutôt à la Chinoise: un film en train de se faire
synopsis: Disillusioned by their suburban lifestyles, a group of middle-class students form a small Maoist cell and plan to change the world by any means necessary. After studying the growth of communism in China, the students decide they must use terrorism and violence to ignite their own revolution.

Charlotte returns to visit her ex-boyfriend Jules, who lives in a small room in Paris. Before she can say a word, Jules launches into a rambling tirade against her. All that Charlotte can do is wait until she can deliver the final put-down Jules deserves. Filmed in 1958, released in 1961.

Jean-Luc Godard mixes video and film in his Grenoble studio, discussing how he secured funding for the film. The action unfolds on two monitors, as a young working-class couple lives in a claustrophobic, high-rise apartment complex and marital discord is set off by the wife’s infidelity.

A couple in crisis—an American journalist and her former French New Wave filmmaker husband—visit an industrial sausage factory to interview its director. However, they are unaware that the factory is occupied by striking workers. Soon they are locked up with the chief in his office.

A montage of images contrasts Palestinian fighters in the Middle East with a French family watching television, combining archive and newly shot footage to explore daily life, political struggle, and the role of media across different worlds.

FilmTitle: The Bridegroom, the Comedienne and the Pimp
databaseFilmTitle: The Bridegroom, the Comedienne and the Pimp
AlternateTitle: Der Bräutigam, die Komödiantin und der Zuhälter
synopsis: Three sequences are linked together in this short film by Straub.

FilmTitle: Not Reconciled, Or Only Violence Helps Where Violence Rules
databaseFilmTitle: Not Reconciled, Or Only Violence Helps Where Violence Rules
AlternateTitle: Nicht versöhnt oder Es hilft nur Gewalt, wo Gewalt herrscht
synopsis: As the directors hopscotch across the chronologies of Heinrich Böll’s novel, moving freely between the 1910s Kaiser autocracy and the 1950s Adenauer economic miracle, they chart the origins and legacy of Nazism, and the moral demands of obedience and sacrifice within the German bourgeois family.

Jean-Marie Straub’s first film after the decease is Danièlle Huillet, is a love poem to her. Le Genou d’Artémide is based on Cesare Pavese’s “Dialogues of Leuco”, that had been already adapted in Ces Rencontres Avec Eux (2006), by Straub et Huillet.

FilmTitle: Introduction to Arnold Schoenberg's Accompaniment to a Cinematic Scene
databaseFilmTitle: Introduction to Arnold Schoenberg's Accompaniment to a Cinematic Scene
AlternateTitle: Einleitung zu Arnold Schönbergs Begleitmusik zu einer Lichtspielscene
synopsis: Depicts the reading of a long letter by Schoenberg to Kandinsky in which he explains that, as a Jew, he cannot accept Kandinsky’s invitation to teach at the Bauhaus.
Embarrassed by his large nose, a romantic poet/soldier romances his cousin by proxy.
Yves Guignard, an autistic child runs away from an oppressive mental institution, and meanders about across the dry and bald landscape of the Cévènnes rocky hills in southern France.
Young, impulsive Rosetta lives a hard and stressful life as she struggles to support herself and her alcoholic mother. Refusing all charity, she is desperate to maintain a dignified job.

Olivier, a carpentry instructor at a rehab facility for boys, initially turns down young Francis’ request to apprentice with him. He eventually gives in and begins to teach the troubled teenager, but then begins to follow the boy through the streets. Why does Oliver seem so interested in him?

A dispossessed young couple living in a bleak industrial Belgian town live off unemployment benefits, panhandling and petty theft. Their lives change forever when they have a baby. The father learns how one avaricious decision can affect the lives of everyone in his orbit.

Ngando and Ndomé are in love. They wish to marry but Ngando cannot afford her dowry. However, when Ndomé becomes pregnant, tradition demands her to take a husband and a marriage with Ngando’s uncle is quickly arranged. In his despair, Ngando decides to do the unthinkable on the day of the wedding.

Bursting with imagination and having seen her fair share of tragedy and fantasy, Amélie is not like any other girl. As she grows up, she becomes a waitress in a Montmartre bar. One day, she discovers that her goal in life is to fix up other people’s troubles by influencing their destinies.

In a dystopian city stands a building inhabited by strange characters. On the ground floor, a butcher with limited meat supply sees his stock increase when some tenants begin to disappear. A young former clown lands a job there, oblivious that he might be the butcher’s next victim.

After carrying out a flawlessly planned hit, a contract killer finds himself caught between a persistent police investigator and a ruthless employer, and not even his armor of fedora and trench coat can protect him.

Middle-aged attorney Pierre falls for a young woman who dances in a discotheque to work her way through medical school. The lovestruck lawyer can’t bring himself to leave his wife over the young woman. When the dancer’s wealthy suitor is murdered, Pierre is accused of the crime.

Ageing safecracker and compulsive gambler Bob lives by night and sleeps by day, and thrives on his nostalgia for the prewar gangster milieu, before the infiltration of the Gestapo upset the delicate balance between cop and criminal. Bob’s going for the big stakes now: the casino vault in Deauville.

In a French village during the Occupation, an old man and his niece are forced to take in a German officer. Whilst his hosts remain mute in his presence, the officer delivers idealistic monologues about a marriage between the two countries, but gradually, he must realise how absurd such a belief is.

Tale of the wholly unholy relationship between a brother and sister, Elisabeth and Paul, who close themselves off from the world by playing an increasingly intense series of mind games. Jealousy and a malevolent undercurrent intrude on their fantasy when Elisabeth invites Agathe to stay with them.

Betrayed by an informant, Philippe Gerbier finds himself trapped in a torturous Nazi prison camp. Although he escapes to rejoin the Resistance in occupied Marseille and exacts his revenge on the informant, Philippe must continue a quiet, seemingly endless battle against the Nazis.

A skilled thief who lives in elegance when he’s not locked up in jail plans an elaborate jewelry store heist with two collaborators picked up almost at random: a notorious escaped convict and an alcoholic ex-cop. With a determined inspector on their tail, they face impossible odds.

The widow Barny lives in Nazi-occupied France, looking after her daughter in a small village. When the Germans arrive, she decides to baptize her and chooses priest Léon Morin to do so; after spending some time with him and converting to Catholicism, she starts feeling an unrequited desire for Léon.

Edouard spends his time chasing criminals. Nightclub owner Simon works with a small crew to execute daring heists with big payoffs. Meanwhile Cathy is torn between them. After a bank robbery in a small Riviera town goes wrong, a game of cat and mouse begins between Edouard and Simon’s gang.

Short after being released from prison, enigmatic gangster Maurice is already involved in what should be a simple heist. While he prepares for it with the help of a friend, he discovers that his trusted partner might be as untrustworthy as he is.

Vincent Cabral returns to France hoping to renew his acquaintance with his younger brother Virgile, whom he has not seen for three years.  Vincent’s return coincides with a spate of terrorist attacks which target the bourgeoisie, mostly wealthy businessmen.

AlternateTitle: Mais im Bundeshuus - le génie helvétique
synopsis: A vertiginous journey down the corridors of the Federal Parliament building in Bern. Constructed as a feature film, it follows the adventures of a parliamentary committee established to create a bill on genetic engineering (Gen-Lex).
This experimental film is a fantastic kaleidoscope of 60’s art happenings and chance juxtapositions, a stunning masterpiece of British avant-garde film.
Johnny Knoxville and his buddies are up to their daredevil comic antics again. And this time they’re coming at ya’ in 3D.

The result of over five years of Super-8 and 16mm filming on New York City streets, Lost Book Found melds documentary and narrative into a complex meditation on city life. The piece revolves around a mysterious notebook filled with obsessive listings of places, objects, and incidents.

When a Vienna museum guard befriends an enigmatic visitor, the grand Kunsthistorisches Art Museum becomes a mysterious crossroads which sparks explorations of their lives, the city, and the ways artworks reflect and shape the world…
An audio-visual explosion of dream-like and documentary excerpts, from Sun Ra to the Black Panthers, depicting black experiences and the concept of black universality.

A cinematic essay in defense of remembering, The Royal Road offers up a primer on Junipero Serra’s Spanish colonization of California and the Mexican American War alongside intimate reflections on nostalgia, the pursuit of unavailable women, and butch identity.

New York City, 1980. In Harlem’s African American and Latinx drag-ball scene, rival houses compete in fierce contests for trophies. Meanwhile, legendary voguers, drag queens, and trans women—including Willi Ninja, Pepper LaBeija, and Venus Xtravaganza—reveal the rules and traditions of the scene.

A Harvard PhD student, was signing a check at a restaurant when she found she could not write her own name. She became progressively ill, losing the ability to even sit in a wheelchair, but when doctors insisted it was psychosomatic, she picked up her camera to document her and other four patients.
A single mother, plagued by the violent death of her husband, battles with her son’s fear of a monster lurking in the house, but soon discovers a sinister presence all around her.

In April 2014, 16 Sherpas died in an avalanche while escorting a group of mountaineers up Everest. It was merely the latest in a series of escalating incidents that have cast a light on the sometimes uneasy alliance between  wealthy climbers and the Sherpas.
In the Stone House records and recollects a period of life of four years in Rural New Jersey.
Maria and Tony find themselves on opposite sides of a New York City gang war in a musical reimagining of Romeo and Juliet.

Brendan Byers III, one of the richest men in America, has been pronounced 4-F and can’t serve his country in it’s fight against Hitler. However, Byers is not the kind of man who takes “No” for an answer and so a recruits other 4-F’s to fight against the Axis powers.
To improve his social life, a nerdish professor drinks a potion that temporarily turns him into the handsome, but obnoxious, Buddy Love.

Toward the end of Jerry Lewis’s Paramount studio period, Lewis slapped together this bitter comedy about Hollywood phoniness and fame that has to be the most rancid portrait of the Hollywood star system in the Rat Pack era this side of Clifford Odets.

After his girl leaves him for someone else, Herbert gets really depressed and starts searching for a job. He finally finds one in a big house which is inhabited by many, many women. Can he live in the same home with all these females?
Suicidal nerd seeks help from psychiatrist, runs into various nutty characters.

Gerald Clamson (Jerry Lewis) is a bank examiner who loves fishing. Unfortunately one day at the ocean he reels in an injured gangster in a scuba diving suit named Syd Valentine. Syd tells Gerald about the diamonds he had stolen from the other gangsters and hands him a map.
The second of Jerry Lewis’ directorial endeavors, The Errand Boy, like its predecessor The Bellboy, is essentially a series of “spot gags,” some hilarious, others only moderately amusing.

Lou Andreas Sand, a once famous model, recalls her past as she tries to make success in the modeling world of New York, her stressful workdays, her affair with Mark, an advertising executive, her friendship with photographer Aaron, and her downward spiral into ruin.

A priest is sent to a remote convent to investigate an outbreak of demonic possession. Mother Joan claims she has eight demons raging within her. As the priest struggles against the forces of darkness, he is faced with the choice of sacrificing his own purity and saving the convent from evil.
Based on documents and evidence of the period, Death of the President is a reconstruction of the few December days of 1922 when Polish political life was shadowed by fascism.

Two people, a man, who might be a killer on the run, and a woman share a compartment on a crowded night train bound for the Baltic resort of Hel. Kawalerowicz turns a thriller into an intriguing character study of ordinary people in unusual circumstances.
The relativity of events – the facts, circumstances and feelings of instability.
A trio of robbers, two brothers and their twisted genius leader, invade a lightship, but don’t reckon on the crew fighting back.

15-year-old Mike takes a job at the local swimming baths, where he becomes obsessed with an attractive young woman, Susan, who works there as an attendant. Although Susan has a fiancé, Mike does his best to sabotage the relationship, to the extent of stalking both her and her fiancé.
A fast-paced comedy about a young Belgian car nut and hairdresser’s apprentice, his girlfriend, and their legal and illegal attempts to get a Porsche under him for his nearing debut race.
This Polish drama chronicles the rebelliousness of the country’s youth as it presents episodes from a young man’s cross-country journeey.
Jerzy Skolimowski’s acclaimed, garlanded British adaptation of a Robert Graves’ short story, is his most unabashedly surreal work.

Ethiopian legends say khat, a stimulant leaf, was found by Sufi Imams in search of eternity. Through a spiritual journey into the khat trade, stories of government repression, mystical fantasies, and risky journeys beyond borders are told, showing the dreams of a youth longing for a better life.

FilmTitle: Those That, at a Distance, Resemble Another
databaseFilmTitle: Those That, at a Distance, Resemble Another
synopsis: A museum-quality replica of a historic elephant tusk is painstakingly created. The hands and tools of conservators in a number of different museums and laboratories embark on a creative process.

In Istanbul, a jazz trumpeter pulls the murdered body of a young woman from the surf. Jimmy leaves for Rio. Rita, a singer, invites him to live with her and helps him recover his equilibrium. Then, into the room walks a woman who looks like Wanda, the murder victim.
Janine Reynaud stars as a nightclub stripper who free-floats through a spectral 60’s landscape littered with dream-figures, dancing midgets and bizarre S&M games.

When outlaw Nat Love discovers that his enemy Rufus Buck is being released from prison he rounds up his gang to track Rufus down and seek revenge. Rufus Buck has his own fearsome crew, including “Treacherous” Trudy Smith and Cherokee Bill, and they are not a group that knows how to lose.

Set in Jia’s native Fenyang in Shanxi Province, the film offers an epic social history of China in radical cultural and economic transformation from Maoism to market capitalism. This transition is charted through the trials and tribulations of a troupe of young performers…
China’s greatest living filmmaker Jia Zhangke travels with acclaimed painter Liu Xiaodong from China to Thailand as they meet everyday workers in the throes of social turmoil.

A town in Fengjie county is gradually being demolished and flooded to make way for the Three Gorges Dam. A coal miner in search of his ex-wife, and a woman looking for her estranged husband, become witness to the societal changes as they visit the village to locate their respective spouses.

At the outskirts of Beijing lies The World Park, a theme park that features replicas of all the wonders of the world. Inside the park works an interconnected group of Chinese youth, all drawn to Beijing with dreams of love and success in the face of globalization.

Contemporary street-corner kids in China make good use of their time, because they want to die young. Before then, Xiao Ji first wants to bed a model; Bin Bin is mainly interested in karaoke. The third film by the greatest talent of the Chinese cinema.

Four people in different provinces are driven to violent ends: An angry miner is enraged by corruption in his village. A migrant discovers the possibilities of owning a firearm. A receptionist is pushed beyond her limits by an abusive client. A young factory worker goes from one job to the next.

Bin is a gangster whose leadership ends when a rival gang comes after his territory. To save him from being beaten to death, Bin’s girlfriend Qiao fires a gun and gets five years in prison for her act of loyalty. When she is released, she hopes to pick up where they left off, but times have changed.
In China, three unemployed miners in the Shanxi province are looking for work. Their last hope for survival is to join an amusement park show where workers are determined to be clowns.

During the Japanese occupation of China, two prisoners are dumped in a peasant’s home in a small town. One is a bellicose Japanese nationalist, the other a nervous translator. Will the townspeople manage to keep the prisoners until the New Year?

FilmTitle: In the Heat of the Sun
databaseFilmTitle: In the Heat of the Sun
synopsis: Beijing, 1970s. The Cultural Revolution has driven most adults to the provinces leaving 14-year-old Monkey and his pals to have free reign over the city. They hang around, get up to no good, and discover the unsolvable mystery of girls.

In warlord-dominated China of the 1920s, notorious bandit Zhang descends upon a remote town posing as its new mayor, an identity he has hijacked from the former mayor, himself a small-time imposter. Hell-bent on making a fast buck, Zhang soon meets his match in the tyrannical local thug Wang.
Outrageous, over-the-top spoof of the airplane disaster movies of the 1970s finds a man who is afraid of flying as the only hope for a disastrous flight that leaves the two pilots ill.
Parody of WWII spy movies in which an American rock and roll singer becomes involved in a Resistance plot to rescue a scientist imprisoned in East Germany.

19th century America. Accountant William Blake has hardly arrived in the godforsaken frontier town of Machine before he’s caught in the middle of a deadly lovers’ quarrel. Wounded and on the run, Blake finds a friend in the outcast Nobody, who guides him on a spiritual journey.

Five taxi drivers across the world have remarkable encounters over one eventful night. In LA, a talent agent decides her cabbie should star in her next movie. In Rome, a non-believing driver finds a dead bishop in his back seat. Meanwhile in Paris, a beautiful blind woman distracts her cabbie…

New York layabout Willie forms an unexpected bond with his young Hungarian cousin Eva when she pays him a surprise visit. Later, Eva moves in with their aunt in Cleveland, and Willie takes his best friend Eddie to see her—a visit that culminates in a strange, eventful trip to Florida.

Three men—an unemployed disc jockey, a small-time pimp, and a hapless Italian tourist—find themselves in the same prison cell for crimes they didn’t commit. Together, they plan their escape, soon ending up in the Louisiana wilds with no refuge in sight.
Jim Jarmusch documents the 1996 concert tour of Neil Young and Crazy Horse, mixing concerts excerpts, interviews of the band and their entourage, and documents of the long history of the band.

A rock ’n roll-obsessed Japanese couple pays a visit to Graceland, the home of Elvis. An inept gang of thugs hide out after a liquor store robbery. A frazzled Italian widow has a ghostly encounter with the King himself. All their stories collide in one sleazy downtown motel in Memphis, Tennessee.

As news from the Vietnam War blares over the radio, David Holzman (L.M. Kit Carson) unloads comic-neurotic monologues to his 16mm camera. When his relationship goes south, he retreats further into the world of celluloid. A landmark mockumentary from the rebel 60s.
A group of aliens plans to invade Australia as a means of taking over the Earth. In order to communicate with the people of Earth, they bring a statue of the long-dead Duke of Edinburgh to life.

A cult classic about sweethearts Brad and Janet who breakdown during a storm and discover the eerie mansion of Dr. Frank-N-Furter, a transvestite scientist. They meet a houseful of wild characters including Frank-N-Furter’s latest creation: a muscular man named “Rocky.”

FilmTitle: In the Name of the Father
databaseFilmTitle: In the Name of the Father
synopsis: Man’s coerced confession to an IRA bombing he didn’t do imprisons his father as well; a British lawyer helps fight for their freedom.

FilmTitle: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
databaseFilmTitle: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
synopsis: Christy Brown, born with cerebral palsy, learns to paint and write with his only controllable limb – his left foot.

With the help of government-issued pamphlets, an elderly British couple build a shelter and prepare for an impending nuclear attack, unaware that times and the nature of war have changed from their romantic memories of World War II.

AlternateTitle: Di bi quan wang da po xue di zi
synopsis: The one-Armed boxer is stalked by the vicious master of the flying guillotine, who’s looking to avenge the death of his disciples.
Released in 1964, just at the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution, and banned for its “bourgeois” content, namely the world of stage performances, the friendship of two actresses.

The Red Detachment of Women tells the story of a slave girl on Hainan Island in 1930, who, with the help of a Red Army soldier, escapes her brutal master and joins a unit of women soldiers organised by the Red Army to overthrow him.

At a village railway station in occupied Czechoslovakia, a bumbling dispatcher’s apprentice longs to liberate himself from his virginity.  Wry and tender, Jiri Menzel’s Academy Award-winning Closely Watched Trains is a masterpiece of human observation.

Set in the 1940s, the film concerns the treatment of suspect “bourgeois elements” – a professor, a saxophonist and a milkman – who are put to work in a junkyard for rehabilitation. Filmed in 1969 but initially banned, Larks on a String was released in 1990 after the fall of the Communist regime.

The first full-length puppet film made by Jiri Trnka. Like the painter Ales who illustrated the national songs, Trnka depicts the traditional customs and tales of the Czech village in six separate sequences: Shrovetide, Spring, Legend About St. Prokop, The Fair, The Feast and Bethlehem.

In 1890s New York, Jewish migrant Jake has assimilated seamlessly into the American community—until Gitl, his wife from back home, arrives on his doorstep. Jake is embarrassed by his traditional wife’s unsophisticated ways, while Gitl discovers adapting to the new life is going to be a challenge.

Julie is a young film student struggling to find a firm direction in life when she meets Anthony. An intense romance blossoms between them, but as the relationship develops it becomes clear that Anthony is not being completely honest, and that this could have devastating consequences for them both.

With her son Edward about to embark on a volunteer trip to Africa, doting mother Patricia wants to give him a good send-off, and gathers her family together for a getaway to a holiday home on the idyllic Isles of Scilly. But gradually, deep fractures within the family set-up begin to surface.

In the aftermath of her relationship with a manipulative older man, film student Julie begins to untangle her fraught love for him in making her graduation film, sorting fact from his elaborately constructed fiction, while also pushing against the constraints of the London independent film scene.

Discontented, 40-something Anna decides to spend her summer holiday apart from her husband, in Tuscany with friends. As the days go by, she finds herself more attuned to their teenage children, gravitating towards Oakley. Sexual tensions simmer and Anna believes she has found a second chance.

AlternateTitle: Recordações da Casa Amarela: Uma Comédia Lusitana
synopsis: A middle-aged man, tormented by illness and various problems, lives on Schubert and movies in Lisbon. Kicked out onto the street after a frustrated attempt to defile the landlady’s daughter, he ends up in a mental institution.

João de Deus is the manager of an ice-cream shop owned by an ex-prostitute. Through an unmoved desire of perfection, he seeks, through cleansing and purity, to attain heaven. The surrounding world, however, does not comply with his decaying vision of lust and decay as a way of achieving his purpose.

João is besotted with Elena, the girlfriend of his pal, Omar. He therefore makes a bet with Omar, the outcome being that either João will win Elena or that Omar will take all of João’s financial assets.

Time passes quietly for João de Deus, the eccentric alter ego of celebrated filmmaker João César Monteiro, as he returns home, observes a beautiful woman, and lingers his gaze over the city. Part of a triade of short films about the misadventures of good old João de Deus.
Monteiro moved far away from the visual opulence defined by his earlier films with his inspired adaptation of radical Swiss writer Robert Walser’s “anti-fairy tale.”

Joao Vuvu, a widower with no family, lives alone in his large house that shows signs of wealth in an old neighborhood of Lisbon. He is not very sociable, if at all, and every day repeats the same routine. Yet when his son gets out of prison, it provokes a desire for regeneration in Joao.

Brooding, alienated Sergio works as a trash collector in Lisbon. At night, he roams the city streets seeking rough, anonymous sex with other men. One night Sergio becomes fascinated with the owner of a sleek motorcycle—a man who seems to be the embodiment of his tormented fantasies.

Ornithologist Fernando loses control of his canoe in a wild nature reserve. He is discovered some way off by two Chinese pilgrims, who force him into extreme behaviour to survive a series of brutal tests. An encounter that will mark the start of a mythical journey into north-eastern Portugal.

Our story begins with Macunaima’s miraculous birth to an old woman in a tiny jungle settlement. Born full grown, he discovers his life’s purpose which leads him and his family/followers on a journey to the Big City.

Joaquim Pinto, who has been living with HIV for more than two decades, looks back at his life in cinema, at his friendships and loves, at the mysteries of art and nature—all of that while undergoing an experimental drug treatment.

In the fast-changing city of Lisbon, Rita and Paulo break with tradition and live the day before their wedding as an ordinary day. However, Rita wants to be sure that Paulo loves her, and decides to cut her long hair. They get married, but Rita’s haircut will bring about many unexpected changes.

In July 1982 the Israeli army laid siege to Beirut. Four years earlier Jocelyne Saab saw her 150-year old childhood home go up in flames. She asked herself: when did all this begin? Every place becomes a historical site and every name a memory.
A Letter from Beirut documents the filmmaker’s return to Beirut during one of the lulls, three years after the outbreak of the civil war, animated by the urge to return.
The ultimate photo-kinetic stroboscopic spectacle. For prismatic glasses.

A documentary crew followed Metallica for the better part of 2001-2003, a time of tension and release for the rock band, as they recorded their album St. Anger, fought bitterly, and sought the counsel of their on-call shrink.
A funny, frightening action adventure movie that pits a teen gang against an invasion of alien monsters. It turns a tower block into a sci-fi playground. It’s inner city versus outer space.
A young rich orphan loses his fiancée to voodoo doll mischief on the part of his housekeeper who is jealous of his attentions…

An army of malevolent little monsters take over a high-tech corporate skyscraper when a cute and intelligent exotic pet is exposed to water. The Mogwai’s owner joins forces with the Trump-like head of the corporation to regain control.

FilmTitle: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
databaseFilmTitle: The Last Black Man in San Francisco
synopsis: Jimmie dreams to reclaim the home his grandfather built in San Francisco. Joined on his quest by his friend Mont, Jimmie searches for belonging in a rapidly changing city. As he struggles to reconnect with his family and reconstruct a community, his hopes blind him to the reality of his situation.

In 1935, thirteen-year-old Briony sees her older sister Cecilia strip off her clothes and plunge into their country house’s fountain. Watching Cecilia is their housekeeper’s son, Robbie. All three of their lives will be changed forever as Robbie and Cecilia become victims of Briony’s imagination.

Hertfordshire, England, 1797. Wealthy Mr. Bingley and his friend, the dashing Mr. Darcy, arrive in town, and Mrs. Bennett sees it as the perfect opportunity to marry off her eligible daughters. But when Elizabeth Bennett meets Mr. Darcy, their equally headstrong natures get in the way of true love.

A car salesman plans to wipe out his personal debts by hiring a pair of colorful crooks to kidnap his wife and have her wealthy father pay the ransom. The haphazard scheme turns sour during a routine pull-over that leaves three dead bodies in its wake.

When Jeff ‘The Dude’ Lebowski is mistaken for Jeffrey Lebowski, two nihilists come to his house to threaten him. In search of recompense, The Dude tracks down Jeffrey, who offers him a job: he needs a bagman to get his kidnapped wife back. But The Dude’s friends Walter and Donny get involved…

The owner of a seedy small-town Texas bar discovers that one of his employees is having an affair with his wife. A chaotic chain of misunderstandings, lies and mischief ensues after he devises a plot to have them murdered by an unpredictable and evil detective.
When a childless couple of an ex-con and an ex-cop decide to help themselves to one of another family’s quintuplets, their lives become more complicated than they anticipated.
A naïve but ambitious business school graduate rapidly moves up the corporate ladder from the mailroom to the executive suite, unaware that he is part of the board of directors’ nefarious scheme.
A Scottish lord becomes convinced by a trio of witches that he will become the next King of Scotland, and his ambitious wife supports him in his plans of seizing power.
Based on the bestselling book by Cormac McCarthy, the film chronicles how a drug-deal-went-wrong changes the lives of various criminals and the local sheriff in a small town bordering Mexico.

When the Italian Mafia threatens to kill a crooked bookie, Irish mob boss Leo O’Bannon refuses to allow it, chiefly because he’s dating the bookie’s sister, gun moll Verna Bernbaum. Leo’s right-hand man, Tom Reagan, is also seeing Verna, on the sly. He is obliged to switch sides when found out.

A satirical tale of a 1940s playwright who accepts an offer to write movie scripts in L.A. Struggling with writers block while staying at the eerie Hotel Earle, an incongruous series of events continues to distract him.

The story of an ordinary man’s search for clarity when his life begins to come apart at the seams. Struggling for equilibrium, he seeks advice from three different rabbis. Can anyone help him cope with his afflictions and become a righteous person, a mensch, a serious man?

In 1961 NYC, folk singer Llewyn Davis fights to find fame amidst obstacles. Relying on the kindness of both friends and strangers, his journey spans Greenwich Village to Chicago club, where he awaits a music mogul who could give him the big break that he desperately needs.

Yearning for liberation from the monotonous grind of breaking rocks on a Mississippi prison farm, suave Ulysses Everett McGill orchestrates a daring escape. Shackled to two eccentric chain-mates, they chase buried treasure, racing against time and nature’s flood, unleashing an epic adventure.
The film chronicles filmmaker Joel DeMott, significant other/film partner Jeff Kreines and filmmaker Mark Rance as they head to Michigan to make a low budget horror film.

In their final year at Muncie’s Southside High School, a group of seniors hurtle toward maturity with a combination of joy, despair, and an aggravated sense of urgency. They are also learning a great deal about life, both in and out of school, and not what school officials think they are teaching.
After moving to a new town, two brothers are convinced that the area is frequented by vampires.
A struggling young jazz dancer (Lucinda Dickey) meets up with two break-dancers. Together they become the sensation of the street crowds. Features ICE-T in his film debut as a club MC.

Philosopher/neurologist Raymond Tallis argues that consciousness is not an internal construct, but rather relational. Through the intriguing notion that humans are physically unable to tickle themselves, he explores the philosophical notion that we become ourselves only through dialogue with others.
In this four-hour epic documentary maker Johan van der Keuken portrays his home town of Amsterdam and the people who live there.

With the use of montage sequences, voiced over with the observations of the children, van der Keuken was able to use artistic expression to portray the sightless children’s unique perspective of the world.
Purushan, a student on his way to Delhi, becomes obsessed with the tragic suicide of a young drummer. He collects many people to go with him to tell the boy’s mother.

Part documentary, part personal essay, this experimental film combines archive imagery with the striking wintry landscapes of Alaska to tell the story of immigrant experience coming into the UK from 1960 onwards.

Purple is a six-channel video installation addressing climate change, human communities and the wilderness. At a time when greenhouse gas emissions from human activities are at their highest levels in history, with people experiencing the significant impacts of climate change, including shifting weather patterns, rising sea levels, and more extreme weather events, Akomfrah’s Purple brings a multitude of ideas into conversation. These include animal extinctions, the memory of ice, the plastic ocean and global warming. Akomfrah has combined hundreds of hours of archival footage with newly shot film and a hypnotic sound score to produce the video installation.

Focuses on the Kwame Nkrumah era in Ghanaian history and paints a portrait of a female African government minister forced into exile after a coup d’état in 1966. Two decades later the protagonist returns to confront the country she left behind.

The Last Angel of History is an exploration of the chromatic possibilities of digital video embedded within a mythology of the future that creates connections between black unpopular culture, outer space and the limits of the human condition.

Stuart Hall emigrated to the UK in 1951 to take up a place at Oxford University, and became a founding figure of cultural studies with an ongoing influence on British intellectual life. This documentary creates a powerful portrait of the life and philosophy of this influential theorist.
An experimental film essay on race and disorder in Britain, filmed in Handsworth and London during the riots of 1985 and incorporating newsreel and archival material.

With this fractured, coolly minimalist thriller, director John Boorman reimagined the film noir for a new era of filmmaking. Lee Marvin stars as Walker, a gangster shot point blank and left for dead on Alcatraz by his partner, who leaves with Walker’s money and his wife.

Bill, a young boy living on the outskirts of London experiences the exhilaration of World War II. During this period, Bill learns about sex, death, love, hypocrisy, and the faults of adults as he prowls the ruins of bombed houses.

Four city slickers canoe down an uncharted section of the Cahulawassee river before a dam project is to takeover the region. Initially mesmerised by the wonders of nature the group soon become fully aware of what it really means to survive outside the safety net of civilization.
Avant-garde home movie, creators unkown, attributed to John C. Hecker.

Sex counselor Sofia has never once had an orgasm. But everything changes when Jamie and James, a gay couple she treats, introduce her to New York’s polysexual sex party scene. As dominatrix Severin helps Sofia to reach climax, Jamie and James’ sex life complicates with the arrival of a third lover.
A team of American scientists investigate the empty, destroyed base of their Norwegian counterparts in Antarctica, only to discover a terrifying life force that can take the form of its prey.

An LA gang’s revenge-fuelled killing spree leads them to a half-abandoned police station in the throes of closing down. Under siege with power and phone lines cut, a lone cop and his skeleton staff recruit a condemned killer from the cells in a desperate battle to survive the night.

After years of institutionalization, Dr. Loomis still cannot penetrate murderer Michael Myers’s psyche. So when Myers escapes right before Halloween, Loomis knows there will be hell to pay. Unleashed, Myers stalks bookish teenager Laurie Strode, who is about to start an evening of baby-sitting.

A nerdy teenager buys an old 1958 Plymouth Fury named Christine, refurbishes it, and becomes obsessed with the car. But he discovers that the Fury is possessed by an evil spirit that empowers his worst impulses, as it wreaks indestructible vengeance upon anyone seeking to do him harm.

In the not-so-distant future of 1997, crime levels have exploded and Manhattan has been transformed into an anarchic maximum-security prison. When an Air Force One is hijacked and the president is stranded on the island, only special-forces soldier turned mercenary Snake Plissken can save him.

Nada, a streetwise drifter, makes a shocking discovery when he finds a pair of special sunglasses that make him see the world for what it really is: aliens disguised as humans are indoctrinating the public with subliminal messages. With the truth now visible, Nada decides to expose the conspiracy.

As a small California town nears its centenary, eerie events unfold: objects animate, Rev. Malone uncovers a town secret, announcer Stevie sees a mystic fire, and Elizabeth finds a mutilated fisherman. A luminous fog envelops the town, bringing death in its wake.

Mabel, desperate and lonely, is married to a Los Angeles municipal construction worker, Nick. Increasingly unstable, especially around others, she craves happiness, but her volatile behaviour convinces Nick that she poses a danger to their family and decides to commit her to an institution.

Lelia, a young African-American girl with a light complexion, meets Tony at a party and they spark a romance. Their relationship crumbles when Tony meets Lelia’s brother Hugh, a talented dark-skinned jazz singer struggling to find work, and he discovers the truth about Lelia’s racial heritage.

Middle-aged husband Richard abruptly tells his wife, Maria, that he wants a divorce. As Richard takes up with a younger woman, Maria enjoys a night out with her friends, and finds solace in the arms of a young man. But as the night proceeds, a series of tense conversations and confrontations occur.

Following the sudden death of their close mutual friend, a trio of middle-aged Long Island family men channel their grief into an epic, multiday bender that takes them from Manhattan to London in a desperate, debauched quest to feel alive again.
The film describes a few days in the life of the writer Robert Harmon and his sister Sarah, two closely bound, emotionally wounded siblings reunited after years apart.

Actress Myrtle Gordon is a functioning alcoholic who is a few days from the opening night of her play, concerning a woman distraught about aging. After one of Myrtle’s fans is killed in a car accident while trying to get her attention, she internalizes the tragedy and goes on a spiritual quest.

FilmTitle: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
databaseFilmTitle: The Killing of a Chinese Bookie
synopsis: Cosmo Vittelli is dedicated to pretenses of composure and self-possession. He also has a major gambling problem, and when he loses at an underground casino run by mobster Mort, he isn’t able to pay up. Mort then offers Cosmo the chance to pay back his debt by knocking off a Mafia-protected bookie.

Tough-talking Gloria Swenson likes her solo life, but when her neighbor’s family is killed by the mob, she becomes the reluctant guardian of their young son. In possession of a book that the gangsters want, Gloria is streetwise enough to know she’d better get out of New York with the kid.

“Before I met you, I thought I was in trouble,” says moneyed museum worker Minnie to longhaired car park attendant Seymour over a hot dog and a coffee. Such is the basis of true love in Minnie and Moskowitz, a shaggy, unusually romantic comedy that is nonetheless pure John Cassavetes.
A vaudeville comic and pretty young dancer realize that they actually are in love with each other, but just when things are starting to look up, the comic start to let success go to his head.
A recently institutionalized woman has bizarre experiences after moving into a supposedly haunted country farmhouse and fears she may be losing her sanity once again.
A devious sexpot steals her husband’s drug money and hides out in a small town where she meets the perfect dupe for her next scheme.

When they set out to take revenge on a girl who sleighted them, Ginger is attacked by a wild animal. Later that night, as Ginger’s wounds miraculously heal, it is clear she is changing. Ginger wants to believe it is nothing more than the onset of puberty; but her sister Brigitte knows better…

A revered Western about a Civil War veteran who embarks on a dangerous journey deep into Indian territory to find his niece after members of his family are killed or abducted by Comanches. However, his motivation becomes increasingly questionable.

As the lawman of a rowdy frontier town where his brother’s killers have taken refuge, Wyatt Earp dedicates himself to bringing the evildoers to justice, a quest that leads to the famous shootout at the O.K. Corral.
A motley crew of passengers are making their way across the Wild West on the Overland stagecoach. Their journey is fraught with danger, with an escaped outlaw and an Apache war party on the loose.

The Joad family is forced off their drought-ridden farm in Oklahoma after it is seized by a bank. When Tom Joad is released from prison they decide to travel to California in search of a better life, but suffer the misfortunes and hardships of the homeless in the Great Depression.

After spending most of his unhappy life in America, Sean Thornton arrives in the little Irish village of Inisfree to find the peace and paradise his mother used to talk about. The first thing to catch his eye (after the cottage where he was born) is the beautiful and fiery Mary Kate Danaher.
Captain Nathan Brittles, on the eve of retirement, takes out a last patrol to stop an impending massive Indian attack. Encumbered by women who must be evacuated, Brittles finds his mission imperiled.

FilmTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
databaseFilmTitle: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
synopsis: Questions arise when Senator Ransom Stoddard returns to a small Western town to attend the funeral of a local man he once saved from Liberty Valance, a notorious outlaw who spread terror across the town. He recalls the time when he was a lawyer and reveals the truth behind his ‘good’ deed.

Shortly after Pearl Harbor, a squadron of PT-boat crews in the Philipines must battle the Navy brass between skirmishes with the Japanese. The title says it all about the Navy’s attitude towards the PT-boats and their crews.

Legendary director John Ford’s final film involving seven dedicated missionary women in China circa 1935 trying to protect themselves from the advances of a Mongolian barbaric warlord and his cut-throat gang of warriors.
Two young drifters guide a Mormon wagon train to the San Juan Valley and encounter cutthroats, Indians, geography, and moral challenges on the journey.

The story of a Welsh valley’s turn-of-the-century descent from pristine paradise to despoiled coal mining region, is told in flashback form by Huw Morgan, an old man who has decided to leave the valley forever.

In John Ford’s somber exploration mythologizing of American heroes, he slowly reveals the character of Owen Thursday, who sees his new posting to the desolate Fort Apache as a chance to claim the military honor which he believes is rightfully his.

Judge William Priest is involved variously in revealing the real identity of Lucy Lake, reliving his Civil War memories, preventing the lynching of a youth and contesting the elections with Yankee Horace K. Maydew.

Ten years in the life of Abraham Lincoln, as he moves from a Kentucky cabin to Springfield, Illinois, to begin his law practice and defends two brothers in an incendiary murder case, suffers the death of his girlfriend Ann, courts his future wife Mary Todd, and agrees to go into politics.
A cavalry officer posted on the Rio Grande must deal with murderous raiding Apaches, his son who’s a risk-taking recruit and his wife from whom he has been separated for many years.
Aboard the freighter Glencairn, the lives of the crew are lived out in fear, loneliness, suspicion and cameraderie.

In Dublin in 1922, Gypo Nolan, a poor ex-army officer, wants to leave Dublin with his girlfriend Katie, who has been reduced to prostitution, but they need 20 pounds to sail to America. Gypo decides to betray his former comrade Frankie to the British authorities for a 20 pound reward.
A dozen British soldiers, lost in a Mesopotamian desert during World War I, are menaced by unseen Arab enemies.

U.S. Navy pilot Frank ‘Spig’ Wead is a fun-loving and rowdy adventurer, but also a fierce proponent of Naval aviation. His dedication to the promotion of the Navy’s flying program is so intense that his marriage and family life suffer.

John Ford’s ideas of duty and community coalesce movingly in this Technicolor CinemaScope epic, surveying fifty years of life at West Point, through the invention of the football passing game and two World Wars, as seen through the life of Marty Maher, an Irish-born physical education instructor.
‘Guns’ Donovan prefers carousing with his pals Doc Dedham and ‘Boats’ Gilhooley, until Dedham’s high-society daughter Amelia shows up in their South Seas paradise.

A widow struggling to maintain her farm is troubled by her son, who yearns to escape from the daily toil by either enlisting in the army or marrying his sweetheart. When he defies his mother and declares his love, she separates them by enlisting him and having him sent to fight in World War I.

Three outlaws on the run after a bank robbery discover a dying woman and her baby in the desert. They swear to bring the newborn to safety to the town of New Jerusalem, even at the risk of any chance of escape and their own freedom and own lives.
Three-hundred starving Cheyenne men, women, and children, forcibly resettled in the barren wastelands of Oklahoma, set out on a desperate 1500-mile trek back to their Yellowstone homeland.

Brandon, a surveyor, dreams of building a railway to the west, but Marsh, a contractor, is sceptical. Abraham Lincoln looks on as their children, Davy Brandon and Miriam Marsh, play together. Brandon sets off with Davy to survey a route.
An unhappy middle-aged banker agrees to a procedure that will fake his death and give him a completely new look and identity – one that comes with its own price.
A former prisoner of war is brainwashed as an unwitting assassin for an international Communist conspiracy.

This Oscar-winning saga which spawned a number of sequels depicts a classic underdog story of a small town boxer named Rocky Balboa who is given the chance to go head-to-head with a heavy weight champion named Apollo Creed.

Daniel, a fatherless teenager, arrives in Los Angeles and becomes the object of bullying by a gang of karate students when he strikes up a relationship with Ali, the gang leader’s ex-girlfriend, so Daniel asks Miyagi, a master of martial arts, to help him learn karate.

After twenty years away Willie McKay returns to his Appalachian homestead to take possession of his family home. On the trip, he falls for a young woman. The only problem is her family has vowed to kill every member of his family due to an ongoing feud that led to him being sent away as a baby.

FilmTitle: Profit Motive and The Whispering Wind
databaseFilmTitle: Profit Motive and The Whispering Wind
synopsis: A tour of the United States’ progressive history, loosely inspired by Howard Zinn’s ‘A People’s History of the United States,’ visiting the resting places of such famed figures as Malcolm X, Susan B. Anthony and Crazy Horse, alongside sites of pivotal struggles, such as the 1770 Boston Massacre.

FilmTitle: The Mad Songs of Fernanda Hussein
databaseFilmTitle: The Mad Songs of Fernanda Hussein
synopsis: This downbeat three-part drama tells a trio of stories that focus on different aspects of America’s reaction to the war in the Persian Gulf.

Young workers are dying because of a mysterious epidemic in a little village in Cornwall. Doctor Thompson is helpless and asks professor James Forbes for help. The professor and his daughter Sylvia travel to Thomson. Terrible things happen soon, beyond imagination or reality.
James Bond is sent to investigate a KGB policy to kill all enemy spies and uncovers an arms deal that potentially has major global ramifications.
John Greyson undertakes an activist’s analysis of the 1985 murder of a gay teacher by five teenage boys in High Park, Toronto. A visually subversive musical in the Brechtian style.
At the grand opening of a colossal but poorly constructed San Francisco skyscraper, a massive fire breaks out that threatens to destroy the tower and everyone in it.
This 1954 classic follows an outback mailman as he travels along the Birdsville Track.
Two little girls muse on marriage and babies, love and death as they create and act out plays in their backyard.
A smooth-talking high schooler by the name of Ferris Bueller convinces his best friend and his girlfriend to cut class one day and go on a raucous adventure around Chicago.

A disparate group of stereotypical highschoolers serve a Saturday detention together. As the day progresses, the barriers between them begin to break and by nightfall, these comrades in crime question whether school will ever be the same.

FilmTitle: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
databaseFilmTitle: The Treasure of the Sierra Madre
synopsis: Two jobless Americans convince a prospector to travel to the mountains of Mexico with them in search of gold. But the hostile wilderness, local bandits, and greed all get in the way of their journey.

After the death of her brother, Rose Sayer must flee German East Africa and finds the only safe conveyance left: a dilapidated river steamboat. The ship is run by the grumpy and usually drunk Charlie, who goes toe to toe with the imperious, straight-laced Rose throughout their perilous journey.

The most famous screen version of Dashiell Hammett’s 1930 novel of the same name is a quintessential Hollywood film noir as private detective Sam Spade gets wrapped up in a web of deception, all surrounding a gold-encrusted life-sized statue of a falcon.
A major heist goes off as planned, until bad luck and double crosses cause everything to unravel.

Billy Tully once had a promising boxing career. Now, at 29, he’s a hopeless drunkard. After sparring at the gym with Ernie, Tully sends the talented hobby boxer to his former trainer Ruben, who arranges a few training bouts, all of which Ernie loses. By then, Tully dares to attempt a comeback…
A sexy divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle in early-sixties Nevada.

19th century Paris. Despondent artist Toulouse-Lautrec, frustrated by his disability, seeks solace in the drink, dance, and distractions at the infamous Moulin Rouge nightclub. An encounter with a girl in desperate need of help brings hope to his lonely life, but romance soon turns to rivalry.
A ballad sung at a Twelfth Night party in Ireland reminds one of the guests of the young boy she loved years before.

In this acclaimed adaptation of the novel by legendary Southern writer Flannery O’Connor, John Huston brings to life a world of vivid, poetic American eccentricity. Brad Dourif, in an impassioned performance, is Hazel Motes, who, fresh out of the army, attempts to open the Church Without Christ.
Under the Volcano follows the final day in the life of self-destructive British consul Geoffrey Firmin (Albert Finney, in an Oscar-nominated tour de force) on the eve of World War II.

FilmTitle: The Man Who Would Be King
databaseFilmTitle: The Man Who Would Be King
synopsis: This adaptation of the famous short story by Rudyard Kipling tells the story of Daniel Dravot and Peachy Carnahan, two ex-soldiers in India when it was under British rule. They decide that the country is too small for them, so they head off to Kafiristan in order to become Kings in their own right.
A defrocked Episcopal clergyman leads a bus-load of middle-aged Baptist women on a tour of the Mexican coast and comes to terms with the failure haunting his life.

FilmTitle: I Think They Call Him John
databaseFilmTitle: I Think They Call Him John
synopsis: The life of an old man, John Cartner Ronson, living alone in a huge block of flats in London since his wife died nine years earlier.

David and Jack, two American college students, are backpacking through Britain when a wolf attacks them. David survives with a bite, but Jack is brutally killed. As David heals in the hospital, he’s plagued by nightmares of his mutilated friend, who warns David that he is becoming a werewolf.
An extremely pampered African prince travels to Queens, New York, and goes undercover to find a wife he respects for her intelligence and strong will.

A friendly gang of toys, led by Woody the cowboy, live happily in their owner, Andy’s room. When jazzed up spaceman, Buzz Lightyear, enters the mix Woody competes with him for Andy’s affection. However the two must form a truce when they become separated from their owner.

When Woody is stolen by an obsessive toy collector, Buzz Lightyear and the gang set out to rescue him. Afraid of the fate that awaits him when Andy grows up, Woody is tempted by the idea of immortality in a museum.

A young, struggling widow and single mother takes in a black housekeeper and her light-skinned daughter. The two women start a pancake store which becomes a successful business, however they face familial, identity, and racial issues along the way.
A writer falls in love with a young socialite and they are married soon after, but her obsessive love for him threatens to be the undoing of both them and everyone else around them.

An aging actor, trying to make a comeback on Broadway, is surprised when his estranged daughter shows up. She is also an actress and is also trying to make it on Broadway. He tries to re-establish his relationship with her while also trying to hide the fact that she is his daughter from the press.
